_about: The branch of John Kastl, one of the seven brothers. See docs/EXTRACTION.md.

sources.quote: The brothers were Peter, Wenzel (James), Jan (John), Joseph, Jakub, Thomas, and Andrew
John Kastl was born 29 November 1835 in Vsepadly, Bohemia, house No. 11
John died 20 December 1890, and was buried at Plasi, Saunders County, Nebraska.
was buried at Plasi, Saunders County, Nebraska.
John Kastl married Marie Kunes in Bohemia.

facts.value: Arrived at Baltimore 14 August 1872 on the S.S. Baltimore, from Bremen

sources.quote: John and Marie Kastl sailed from Bremen, Germany on the ship S.S Baltimore, arriving at the Port of Baltimore on the 14th of August 1872

facts.value: Arrived 14 August 1872 on the S.S. Berlin

sources.quote: John's date of arrival was August 14. With him were his wife, Marie, children: Wenzel 8, Barbara 6, Anna 3, and Josef 11 months. They sailed on the ship SS Berlin.
